meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务动态组建执行、指挥、评审三类智能体团队，实时展示各角色的发言、辩论与决策过程，所有智能体共享同一套上下文记忆，最终产出会议记录、方案或代码。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成复杂任务，或要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发，例如技术架构决策会议、OPC 系统构建等。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 主持人引导讨论，各智能体辩论后收敛出共识

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三步执行

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这个产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析师与财务顾问先发言，再讨论定价

howto.what_en: Claude forms a task-specific team of executor, coordinator and reviewer agents, shows their debate and decisions live, shares one context memory, and delivers meeting notes, plans or code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when you want a managed agent set for a scenario such as an architecture decision meeting or an OPC system build.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate the microservices plan
say_en.note: A host guides debate; agents converge on a decision

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short video
say_en.note: Runs strategy, product architecture, automation steps

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market and finance agents speak first
